paragraphs.text: Zetalpa , "the elder of dawn," is an elder dinosaur from Ixalan .

The opening of the golden city revealed the enormous elder dinosaurs , which were held in stasis during Orazca 's long hibernation in the earth. Each of these monsters embodies one aspect of the magic of the land: The giant pteranodon Zetalpa is a manifestation of white mana and the searing brilliance of the sun.
Jace and Vraska witnessed her awakening.
During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Zetalpa battled a compleated Etali . The battle ended in a draw, Etali broken but Zetalpa bleeding heavily as she flew away.
